data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: application
sections.summary: A computer program designed to perform a specific task on a device; also a formal request, or the act of putting something into practice.

senses.definition: a computer program or piece of software designed to fulfil a specific purpose on a phone, tablet or computer
examples: She downloaded a new application on her smartphone to help manage her daily tasks and schedule.

senses.definition: a formal written request for something, such as a job or a place on a course
examples: He submitted his application to the university three months before the closing date.

senses.definition: the practical use of a theory, skill or idea in a particular situation
examples: The application of artificial intelligence in medicine is growing rapidly.

answers.answer: The new application allows users to translate text into over fifty languages instantly.
He felt great application when the teacher announced that the test had been postponed.
She kept some application in her bag to fix the poster to the classroom wall.
The application was very warm and comfortable to wear during the cold winter months.

sections.question: artificial intelligence
sections.summary: The development of computer systems that can perform tasks which normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language, recognising images or making decisions.

senses.definition: the development of computer systems that can perform tasks which normally require human intelligence, such as speech recognition, decision-making and visual perception
examples: Artificial intelligence is increasingly being used to help doctors diagnose diseases more accurately.

senses.definition: the field of computer science focused on building intelligent machines capable of human-like behaviour
examples: She decided to study artificial intelligence at university after reading about its impact on the job market.

answers.answer: The company uses artificial intelligence to recommend products based on customers' previous purchases.
She showed great artificial intelligence by solving the complex equation entirely in her head.
He bought some artificial intelligence from the technology shop to upgrade his old computer.
The artificial intelligence was very light and easy to carry between classrooms each day.

sections.question: digital
sections.summary: Relating to or using computer technology, especially the internet; also describing systems that use data as numbers rather than as physical signals.

senses.definition: relating to or using computer technology, the internet, or electronic devices
examples: The school moved to a digital system for recording student attendance each morning.

senses.definition: using a system that represents data as a series of the numbers 0 and 1
examples: Digital cameras store images as data rather than on traditional film.

senses.definition: the area of digital or online technology (informal use)
examples: Many traditional businesses are now moving into the digital to reach wider audiences.

answers.answer: The museum replaced all its paper guides with a digital version that visitors could download.
She used digital to paint the walls of her bedroom a bright shade of blue at the weekend.
He felt very digital after spending the whole afternoon working in the school computer lab.
The digital weather made it completely impossible to hold the outdoor sports day as planned.

sections.question: innovation
sections.summary: A new idea, method or product that has been introduced; also the process of creating and introducing new ideas or methods.

senses.definition: a new idea, method or product that has never been used or done before
examples: The touchscreen was a major innovation that transformed how people interact with their devices.

senses.definition: the process of creating and introducing new ideas, methods or products
examples: The company encourages innovation by giving its engineers time each week to develop their own ideas.

answers.answer: The company is widely admired for its innovation, having launched several ground-breaking products.
She showed great innovation in finishing all her classwork well before the deadline each week.
He kept his innovation carefully in his school bag and showed it to the teacher after class.
The teacher gave the class an innovation to research and present before the end of the term.

sections.question: invention
sections.summary: Something that has been designed or created for the first time; also the process of creating something new.

senses.definition: a thing that has been made or designed for the first time by someone
examples: The telephone is often described as one of the greatest inventions of the nineteenth century.

senses.definition: the act of creating or designing something that has never existed before
examples: The invention of the internet changed the world more rapidly than almost any technology before it.

answers.answer: The printing press is considered one of the most important inventions in all of human history.
She wore her most impressive invention to the school fashion show at the end of the autumn term.
He felt great invention when he discovered that his science project had won first prize.
The teacher handed each student an invention to complete and submit before the following Friday.

sections.question: programming
sections.summary: The process of writing instructions for a computer in a programming language so that it can perform specific tasks.

senses.definition: the process of writing a set of instructions, in a programming language, that tells a computer what to do
examples: She taught herself programming by following free online tutorials every evening for six months.

senses.definition: the activity of planning and scheduling content for television or radio
examples: The channel changed its programming to include more educational content for younger viewers.

answers.answer: The school now offers programming as part of its core curriculum from the age of eleven.
He showed incredible programming at the school sports day and finished first in three races.
She had programming in her pencil case that she used during every afternoon technology class.
The teacher gave each student programming to complete and hand in by the end of the week.

sections.question: software
sections.summary: The programs and operating information used by a computer, as opposed to the physical hardware components.

senses.definition: programs used to operate a computer or to perform specific tasks, as opposed to the physical components of the machine
examples: The school purchased new educational software to help students improve their reading and maths skills.

answers.answer: The design software allows users to create professional graphics without any specialist training.
She put the software carefully into her bag before leaving the technology classroom after lunch.
He wrote the software neatly in his exercise book and handed it to the teacher for marking.
The software was so heavy that two members of staff were needed to carry it upstairs.

sections.question: technology
sections.summary: The application of scientific knowledge to create tools, machines and systems that solve practical problems; also refers to the machines and devices themselves.

senses.definition: the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry and everyday life
examples: Modern technology has completely transformed the way we communicate and access information.

senses.definition: the machinery and equipment developed from scientific knowledge
examples: The hospital invested in the latest technology to improve patient diagnosis and treatment.

answers.answer: The school has invested in new technology to improve the quality of teaching in every classroom.
She showed great technology in solving the difficult maths problem without any help from the teacher.
He felt very technology after spending the whole evening working alone in the computer lab.
The teacher gave each student some technology to eat during the lunch break as a special treat.

sections.question: user interface
sections.summary: The point of interaction between a person and a computer or device, including all the menus, buttons and features that allow the user to control and communicate with it.

senses.definition: the visual layout and controls through which a person interacts with a computer program or device, including menus, buttons and icons
examples: The new app has a very clean user interface that makes it easy for anyone to navigate.

answers.answer: The designers spent months perfecting the user interface to make the app as simple as possible.
She had excellent user interface skills and was always friendly and polite to everyone she met.
He printed out the user interface and distributed one copy to every student in the class.
The user interface was very comfortable to wear throughout the virtual reality demonstration.

sections.question: virtual reality
sections.summary: A computer-generated simulation of a three-dimensional environment that a person can explore and interact with using special equipment such as a headset.

senses.definition: a computer-generated, three-dimensional environment that can be explored and interacted with using special equipment such as a headset and gloves
examples: The museum uses virtual reality to allow visitors to experience life in ancient Rome first-hand.

answers.answer: Students used virtual reality headsets to explore the surface of Mars during the science lesson.
She showed great virtual reality in completing all the tasks the teacher had set for the week.
He wrote a virtual reality for his history class describing what ancient Rome must have looked like.
She showed great virtual reality when she imagined the ancient city from the painting on the wall.
